convert_modelopt_nvfp4_to_compressed_ten: convert ModelOpt NVFP4 quantized model weights to compressed-tensors format using ModelOptNvfp4Converter
apply_fp8_block_quantization: apply FP8-Block quantization to specified self_attn Linear layers of a DeepSeek R1 model
run_model_free_ptq_pipeline: run model_free_ptq to quantize a DeepSeek-R1-NVFP4 model with FP8-Block scheme and save to directory
target_quantize_self_attn_layers: target self_attn layers like kv_a_proj_with_mqa, q_a_proj, o_proj, q_b_proj for FP8-Block quantization
convert_mlp_proj_weights: convert MLP projection layer weights (gate_up, gate, up, down_proj) from NVFP4 to compressed-tensors format
